name: code-review-graph
description: Persistent incremental codebase knowledge graph. MCP tools cover hub/bridge detection (betweenness centrality), surprise scoring (unexpected cross-community coupling), knowledge-gap analysis (isolated nodes, untested hotspots), execution-flow tracing, and risk-scored diff review (detect_changes maps a diff to affected functions/flows/test gaps). Requires 'code-review-graph build' inside each project before use — see the code-review-graph-analyst agent and repo-audit skill for how this repo consumes it.
post_install_message: Run 'code-review-graph build' inside each project where you want to use it (creates .code-review-graph/graph.db). Re-run 'code-review-graph update' after pulling changes to keep the graph fresh — a stale graph gives wrong risk/impact scores.
